title: Determining the biomarkers and pathogenesis of myocardial infarction combined with ankylosing spondylitis via a systems biology approach.
authors: Liu, Chunying; Peng, Chengfei; Jia, Xiaodong; Yan, Chenghui; Liu, Dan; Zhang, Xiaolin; Song, Haixu; Han, Yaling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过系统生物学方法筛选心肌梗死合并强直性脊柱炎的生物标志物，虽构建了TF-miRNA调控网络并做分子对接，但核心是疾病标志物与免疫浸润，非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，方法上仅浅层涉及TF网络和对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is linked to an increased prevalence of myocardial infarction (MI). However, research dedicated to elucidating the pathogenesis of AS-MI is lacking. In this study, we explored the biomarkers for enhancing the diagnostic and therapeutic efficiency of AS-MI. Datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus database. We employed weighted gene co-expression network analysis and machine learning models to screen hub genes. A receiver operating characteristic curve and a nomogram were designed to assess diagnostic accuracy. Gene set enrichment analysis was conducted to reveal the potential function of hub genes. Immune infiltration analysis indicated the correlation between hub genes and the immune landscape. Subsequently, we performed single-cell analysis to identify the expression and subcellular localization of hub genes. We further constructed a transcription factor (TF)-microRNA (miRNA) regulatory network. Finally, drug prediction and molecular docking were performed. S100A12 and MCEMP1 were identified as hub genes, which were correlated with immune-related biological processes. They exhibited high diagnostic value and were predominantly expressed in myeloid cells. Furthermore, 24 TFs and 9 miRNA were associated with these hub genes. Enzastaurin, meglitinide, and nifedipine were predicted as potential therapeutic agents. Our study indicates that S100A12 and MCEMP1 exhibit significant potential as biomarkers and therapeutic targets for AS-MI, offering novel insights into the underlying etiology of this condition.
abstract_zh: 强直性脊柱炎（ankylosing spondylitis, AS）与心肌梗死（myocardial infarction, MI）患病率增加相关。然而，专门阐明AS-MI发病机制的研究尚缺乏。在本研究中，我们探索了用于提高AS-MI诊断和治疗效率的生物标志物。数据集来源于基因表达综合数据库（Gene Expression Omnibus）。我们采用加权基因共表达网络分析和机器学习模型筛选核心基因。设计了受试者工作特征曲线和列线图以评估诊断准确性。进行了基因集富集分析以揭示核心基因的潜在功能。免疫浸润分析表明核心基因与免疫景观之间的相关性。随后，我们进行了单细胞分析以确定核心基因的表达和亚细胞定位。我们进一步构建了转录因子（transcription factor, TF）-微小RNA（microRNA, miRNA）调控网络。最后，进行了药物预测和分子对接。S100A12和MCEMP1被确定为核心基因，它们与免疫相关生物过程相关。它们表现出高诊断价值，并主要在髓系细胞中表达。此外，24个TFs和9个miRNAs与这些核心基因相关。Enzastaurin、meglitinide和nifedipine被预测为潜在治疗药物。我们的研究表明，S100A12和MCEMP1作为AS-MI的生物标志物和治疗靶点具有显著潜力，为该疾病的潜在病因提供了新见解。
